notes: Day 18 (Theophilus) continues; no arke on this page. Both columns cut at page end, continuing on p071 (Ge'ez ends "በመካን", Amharic ends "በእመቤታችን"; trailing ፡ kept so the join adds a space). Numerals ፰-፲፪ inferred from sequence (print tiny; ¶፲፩ label glyph unclear). Uncertain Ge'ez readings kept near print: ኀበ (print ነበ), ዘኀደገ (print ዘንደገ), ብዙኀ, ለእግዚእነ (print ለእግዚእን), ወሣልሱ (print ወማልሱ), አሐንያን (as printed, cf. ሐንያን in ¶፲፩, probably a verb for building), ወእንዘ ይሕንፅ (print ወአንዘ), ለብዙኃት (print ለብዙ;ንት). Ge'ez ¶፲ year count printed as a glyph string like ፲ቱ፻፲ት; entered as ፯ቱ፻ to agree with Amharic ሰባት መቶ (700): NEEDS CHECK against the PDF. Amharic በአየው ጊዜ and እየአንዳንዱ kept as printed. Both columns end with continuation words, no arke here.
